comparison.objective: Hold an enabling lever continuously while the other arm moves a part through a cell; candidate clears the mechanism and then actuates a separate guarded test control.
comparison.physical_skill: Sustained one-arm hold-to-run actuation coordinated with other-arm transport versus lockout tooling, collar manipulation, relocking, hand/tool clearance, and subsequent control actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Lever held for the entire part motion, part released in output, then lever released versus two safe dynamic cycles after adjustment and clearance.
comparison.reason: Both concern guarded industrial control, but the record tests continuous concurrent enabling while manipulating a part; the candidate explicitly tests sequential clearance and separate guarded cycling plus damper commissioning.
